Table: status

- air_temp_max numeric

- track_temp_min numeric
- track_temp_max numeric

- wind_speed_max numeric

Relationships:
- constructor_results.constructor_id -> constructors.constructor_id
- constructor_results.race_id -> races.race_id
- constructor_standings.constructor_id -> constructors.constructor_id
- constructor_standings.race_id -> races.race_id
- driver_standings.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- driver_standings.race_id -> races.race_id
- lap_times.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- lap_times.race_id -> races.race_id
- pit_stops.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- pit_stops.race_id -> races.race_id
- practice_results.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- practice_results.race_id -> races.race_id
- qualifying.constructor_id -> constructors.constructor_id
- qualifying.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- qualifying.race_id -> races.race_id
- races.circuit_id -> circuits.circuit_id
- races.year -> seasons.year
- results.constructor_id -> constructors.constructor_id
- results.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- results.race_id -> races.race_id
- results.status_id -> status.status_id
- sprint_results.constructor_id -> constructors.constructor_id
- sprint_results.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- sprint_results.race_id -> races.race_id
- sprint_results.status_id -> status.status_id
- tire_stints.driver_id -> drivers.driver_id
- tire_stints.race_id -> races.race_id
- weather.race_id -> races.race_id

Important notes:
- A driver's full name is drivers.forename plus drivers.surname.
- results contains only main races; sprint races are in sprint_results.
- results.position is NULL when the driver was not classified; position_text then holds a code (R = retired, D = disqualified, E = excluded, W = withdrew, F = failed to qualify, N = not classified). position_order orders every driver of a race. A race win is results.position = 1.
- driver_standings and constructor_standings are cumulative after each race; a season's final standings are the ones after its last race (the highest round of that year).
- Lap and race times are stored as text (lap_times.time, results.time, fastest_lap_time, q1-q3, pit_stops.duration); use the milliseconds columns to compare or calculate times.
- Data coverage: qualifying from 1994, lap_times from 1996, pit_stops from 2011, sprint_results from 2021; practice_results, tire_stints and weather only for 2025-2026. The 2026 season is incomplete.

results.question: Ki nyerte a 2007-es világbajnokságot?
results.ground_truth_sql: SELECT d.forename, d.surname FROM driver_standings ds JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id JOIN drivers d ON ds.driver_id = d.driver_id WHERE r.year = 2007 AND ds.position = 1 AND r.round = (SELECT MAX(round) FROM races WHERE year = 2007);

SELECT c.name AS constructor_name
FROM constructors c
JOIN constructor_standings cs ON c.constructor_id = cs.constructor_id
JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
WHERE r.year = 2007
ORDER BY cs.points DESC
LIMIT 1;
